concerns.text: FR-004 requires evaluation on a held‑out test set, but no task creates or validates a train/test split nor runs metrics on that split. Add a task (e.g., T0XX) that partitions the preprocessed dataset into train and held‑out test subsets and verifies metric calculation on the test set.

SC-002 measures model performance on a held‑out test set, yet the task list lacks any step that generates the test set or records its metrics. Provide a task (e.g., T0YY) that runs the evaluation pipeline on the held‑out data and stores the results.

The dataset schema includes `source_name` and `source_id` fields, but no task explicitly validates that every record contains non‑empty, correct source metadata, violating Principle VII. Add a verification task (e.g., T0ZZ) that checks these fields after merging.

The identifier `T021` is used for two distinct tasks (streaming integration and stratified nested CV implementation) as `T021a` and `T021b`. This duplicate base ID creates ambiguity for traceability. Rename one of the tasks to a unique base ID (e.g., `T022a`/`T022b`).
